what: A number counts to the spoken value in a card, then to the new value with the old one struck; a row of people lights and the leavers drop away.
vitals: timing is fixed in the move; times come from the words that cue it
skin: brand skin colours only (ink, cream, mint, the series colour); never a copied hex
